info.title: LAHAP API
info.description:
LAHAP — SME catering subscription & fulfillment platform. Generated from `contract.prisma` and the decisions in AGENTS.md (2026-11-02).

**Conventions**
- Base URL ends in `/api`. JSON everywhere except uploads (`multipart/form-data`) and `/realtime/stream` (SSE).
- Success: `{ "data": …, "meta"?: … }`. Lists: `{ "data": [...], "meta": { page, limit, total, totalPages, hasNextPage, hasPrevPage } }` with `?page=&limit=` (max 100).
- Errors: `{ "error": { "code", "message", "issues"? } }`. 400 validation, 401 missing/invalid token, 403 role not allowed, 404 not found (also for other users' resources), 409 uniqueness/still referenced, 422 business rule or state (cut-off passed, wrong slot status, unavailable package).
- Auth: `Authorization: Bearer <accessToken>`; each operation lists its roles in `x-roles`. Refresh with `/auth/refresh` (rotates the refresh token); `/auth/logout` revokes the refresh token. Access tokens are stateless and stay valid until they expire.
- **Terminology:** `Subscription` = PRD "Pesanan" (order); `Order` = PRD "Slot" (one portion on one schedule); `MenuSchedule` = "Jadwal Menu".
- Status values are Indonesian and case-sensitive (`Siap Diambil` has a space). Derived labels (`displayStatus`, meal-time `range`, `isAvailable`, `doneOnline`) are computed, never stored.
- Money is Rp as a JSON number with up to 2 decimals. Dates are `YYYY-MM-DD` and times `HH:mm` in Asia/Jakarta; timestamps are ISO 8601 Asia/Jakarta wall-clock time with its offset and milliseconds (`2026-11-03T08:00:00.000+07:00`).
- Photos: upload via `POST /files`, send the returned key as `photoKey`; responses add a short-lived signed `photoUrl`.

post.description:
**Public** (no token).

Creates a `CUSTOMER` and signs in immediately (UC-01). 409 when the phone or email is taken.

Rate-limited per client IP (default 10 requests per 60 s); over the limit it returns 429 with `Retry-After`.

The refresh token is also set as the `lahap_refresh` cookie (`HttpOnly`, `Path=/api/auth`, `Max-Age` = `refreshExpiresIn`; `SameSite`/`Secure` from `AUTH_COOKIE_SAME_SITE`/`AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE`). Browsers should rely on the cookie and send requests with `credentials: "include"`; `refreshToken` stays in the body for non-browser clients.

**Public** (no token).

One login for every role (UC-13); redirect by `user.role`. Inactive accounts get 401 `INVALID_CREDENTIALS`.

Rate-limited per client IP (default 10 requests per 60 s); over the limit it returns 429 with `Retry-After`.

The refresh token is also set as the `lahap_refresh` cookie (`HttpOnly`, `Path=/api/auth`, `Max-Age` = `refreshExpiresIn`; `SameSite`/`Secure` from `AUTH_COOKIE_SAME_SITE`/`AUTH_COOKIE_SECURE`). Browsers should rely on the cookie and send requests with `credentials: "include"`; `refreshToken` stays in the body for non-browser clients.

**Public** (no token).

Returns a new token pair and sets a new `lahap_refresh` cookie. Reads the refresh token from the body, or from the `lahap_refresh` cookie when the body has none. Refresh tokens are stored server-side and **rotated**: each refresh revokes the presented token, so keep only the newest one. Presenting a token that was already revoked (rotated or logged out) is treated as theft: every refresh token of that user is revoked and the user must sign in again. 401 `MISSING_TOKEN` when neither is sent; 401 `INVALID_TOKEN` when the refresh token is invalid, revoked or unknown, or the user is gone or inactive; 401 `TOKEN_EXPIRED` when it has expired.

**Public** (no token).

Revokes the refresh token and clears the `lahap_refresh` cookie. Reads the refresh token from the body, or from the `lahap_refresh` cookie when the body has none, like `/auth/refresh`. No access token is needed, so logout still works after the access token expired. Access tokens are stateless and stay valid until they expire (`expiresIn`), so the client must discard it. Always returns 204, also without a token or with an invalid, expired or already revoked one.

204.description: Logged out; the refresh token is revoked. Discard the access token.

SubscriptionStatus.description: Order (`subscription`) status, PRD BR-21. Only `Success` counts for production, couriers, revenue and churn (BR-22). `Pending` expires after `paymentTimeoutMinutes` (BR-20).

SubscriptionDisplayStatus.description: Derived from dates for `Success` orders (never stored): `Akan Datang` before startDate, `Aktif` between startDate and endDate, `Selesai` after endDate. `null` for other statuses.

PurchaseType.description: `Online` = gateway only (never `CASH`); `Offline` = at the cashier, gateway or `CASH` (UC-03). Set once at checkout.

OrderPeriod.description: Order period offered by a package (UC-05).

OrderStatus.description: Slot (`order`) status, PRD BR-23, forward-only. Delivery: Terjadwal → Disiapkan → Diantar → Selesai. Pick-up: Terjadwal → Disiapkan → Siap Diambil → Selesai. Skip: → Dilewati (before food-ready). Courier obstacles are notes, not a status.

PaymentMethod.description: `CASH` (offline cashier, verified by admin), `MIDTRANS` (gateway, channel not chosen yet) or `MIDTRANS_<PAYMENT_TYPE>` once the webhook reports the channel.

PaymentType.description: `DELIVERY_SERVICE_UPGRADE` is reserved for the post-release change-delivery-method feature (PRD §7.5); the MVP only creates `SUBSCRIPTION`.

PaymentStatus.description: `Refund` = the admin confirmed a manual refund done outside the app (refund flow is still being revised by the PM).

AnnouncementScope.description: `GLOBAL` = everyone; `PACKAGE` = customers of `packageId`; `SCHEDULE` = customers of one service day `menuScheduleId` (e.g. a BR-26 menu change).

DiscountType.description: How `discountValue` is read: `Persen` = percent (0–100) of the food subtotal, `Nominal` = Rp amount.

MealTimeRange.description: Derived label: Pagi 00:00–10:59, Siang 11:00–15:59, Malam 16:00–23:59. Never stored.

MealTime.description: A meal time as returned by the API (`toMealTimeView`). Inputs send only the `ClockTime` string.

phone.description: Phone / WhatsApp number. Accepts `0812…`, `+62812…` or `62812…`; stored normalized to digits starting with `62`.

RefreshRequest.description: A refresh token, for `/auth/refresh` and `/auth/logout`. The token is read from the body, or from the `lahap_refresh` cookie when the body has none (the body wins when both are sent). On refresh the server re-checks that the user exists and `isActive`.

refreshToken.description: Refresh token from login/register/refresh. Optional when the `lahap_refresh` cookie is sent.

AuthSession.description: Issued session: a JWT pair. The access token is stateless; the refresh token is stored server-side, rotated on every refresh and revoked by logout.

basePrice.description: Price per portion (Rp) before discounts and delivery.

periods.description: Periods this package offers (at least one).

deliveryTimes.description: Meal times typed by the admin for this package (BR-05), ascending.

deliveryFreeRadius.description: Free delivery radius in km. Package override; `null` = use the business default (`Settings`).

deliveryMaxDistance.description: Max delivery distance in km. Package override; `null` = use the business default (`Settings`).

deliveryPricePerKm.description: Rp per km beyond the free radius. Package override; `null` = use the business default (`Settings`).

photoUrl.description: Signed, expiring URL generated from `photoKey` on each read. Not stored; do not save it.

isAvailable.description: Derived: `isActive && startAt <= now && (endAt == null || now < endAt)`.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (auto-updated).

activeSubscriberCount.description: Admin only: customers with a `Success` order on this package that has not ended (UC-19).

allowStackWithTier.description: `true` = applied after the tier discount; `false` = only the larger of tier or promo applies.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (auto-updated).

code.description: Unique code (stored uppercase). Omit to have the server generate one (UC-47).

validUntil.description: Expiry. Defaults to 14 days from now (UC-47).

PromoCodeUpdate.description: Admin partially updates a promo code.

Subscription.description: A customer's order (PRD "Pesanan"). Delivery vs pick-up applies to every slot (BR-13). Recipient, delivery point and the full price breakdown are snapshotted at checkout and never change afterwards (BR-16).

tierId.description: Tier that granted `tierDiscount`; `null` if none or the tier was deleted.

startDate.description: First slot date; drives the cut-off (BR-09).

isDelivery.description: `true` = courier delivery, `false` = pick-up, for every slot.

deliveryFeePerSlot.description: Fee per delivered slot; 0 for pick-up. Never discounted.

needsRefund.description: Paid and then `Dibatalkan`; cleared when the admin confirms the manual refund.

adminNote.description: Reason for an admin correction; `null` for normal flow changes.

DeliveryObstacle.description: Courier/admin obstacle note on a slot. Notifies the customer; never changes the status (BR-23). Append-only.

authorId.description: Courier or admin who wrote it.

Order.description: One slot = one portion = one delivery or pick-up for one schedule (package + date + meal time). Unique per `(subscriptionId, menuScheduleId)`.

courierId.description: Courier assigned by the admin (delivery slots only).

usesAlternativeMenu.description: `true` = the kitchen switched this slot to the schedule's alternative menu (allergy clash, BR-24).

completedAt.description: Derived from history: when the slot reached `Selesai`.

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (auto-updated).

menu.description: Derived: the schedule's primary menu, or the alternative when `usesAlternativeMenu`.

OrderStatusCorrection.description: Admin status correction (UC-27). Still forward-only; recorded in `OrderStatusHistory` with the note.

adminNote.description: Why the status is being corrected. Stored on the history row.

CourierAssignmentInput.description: Assign (or unassign) a courier on delivery slots (UC-27). Either explicit `orderIds` (e.g. move one delivery), or every delivery slot of `date` + `deliveryTime` (optionally one `packageId`). Stored per slot (`order.courierId`); there are no shift rows, so slots created later are not auto-assigned.

Payment.description: Payment for an order. Online = Midtrans webhook; cash = verified by the admin.

packageId.description: Required when `target = PACKAGE` (customers with a `Success` order on it).

Settings.description: The single `business` row: kitchen location, delivery defaults and payment timeout. Packages may override the delivery values.

whatsappNumber.description: Business contact (`62…`); reserved for future features.

deliveryMaxDistance.description: Default max delivery distance (km); beyond it delivery is hidden at checkout.

deliveryPricePerKm.description: Default Rp per km beyond the free radius.

paymentTimeoutMinutes.description: Minutes before an unpaid `Pending` order expires (BR-20).

updatedAt.description: When the record was last changed (auto-updated).

ToCookMenu.description: Portions to cook for one menu at one meal time. Primary and alternative portions are separate lines.

ToCookIngredient.description: Total quantity of one ingredient for the day.

SpecialCategoryEntry.description: A slot that needs special handling (UC-39).

orderId.description: Slot ID (use with the food-ready endpoint).

reasons.description: `ALLERGY_CLASH` = profile allergens ∩ primary menu allergens; `ALLERGY_NOTE` = the customer has a free-text `allergyNote`; `NOTE` = the order has `notes`.

usesAlternativeMenu.description: Whether the slot is already switched to the alternative.

deliveryTime.description: Meal-time filter applied, or `null` for all.

menus.description: Portions per menu and meal time.

DashboardStats.description: Owner dashboard (UC-33): income for the period, trending menus, inventory shortages and admin notifications.

income.description: Income for the period (same numbers as `IncomeReport.total`).

shortages.description: Ingredients short for the next 7 days.

unreadNotificationCount.description: Unread admin notifications (e.g. next week's menu not published, UC-24).

ChurnCustomer.description: Churned customer (BR-28): has a `Success` history, no active order, and last `endDate` more than 14 days ago.

lastPackageName.description: Package of the most recent order (`{paket_terakhir}`).

ChurnFollowUpRequest.description: Build a WhatsApp follow-up for one churned customer from a template.

promoCode.description: Code to put in `{kode_promo}`, if any.

ChurnFollowUp.description: Generated follow-up. Nothing is stored; the admin opens `whatsappUrl`.

CourierScheduleEntry.description: Courier duty overview for one date + meal time (UC-27).

courier.description: Courier on all these slots, or `null` if unassigned/mixed (see counts).

ProfileUpdate.description: Update your own profile (UC-41). Role and isActive cannot be changed here.

phone.description: Phone / WhatsApp number. Accepts `0812…`, `+62812…` or `62812…`; stored normalized to digits starting with `62`.

allergyNote.description: Free-text allergies not in the list.

subscriptionDays.description: Accumulated paid service days that count towards tiers (UC-50).

nextTier.description: Next tier up, or `null` at the top.

BusinessInfo.description: Public business profile: pick-up location and contact.

CheckoutRequest.description: Order input, shared by preview and create. Slot selection depends on `period` (UC-05, UC-06): `Harian` sends `menuScheduleIds` (any published slots); `Mingguan` sends `periodStart` (a Monday) and `Bulanan` sends `periodStart` (the 1st of the month), both with `deliveryTimes`, and the server takes every published slot of that week/month at those times. Ordering is allowed until 23:59:59 the day before the first slot (BR-09).

periodStart.description: `Mingguan`: the Monday of the week; `Bulanan`: the first day of the month.

deliveryTimes.description: `Mingguan`/`Bulanan`: meal times repeated on every service day.

isDelivery.description: `true` = courier delivery (needs address + pin within max distance), `false` = pick-up.

notes.description: Optional non-allergy note for the kitchen and courier (UC-07).

promoCode.description: Optional promo code (UC-49). An invalid code never blocks the order; see `CheckoutPreview.promo`.

CheckoutSlotPreview.description: One slot that the order would create.

hasAlternative.description: The schedule has an alternative menu the kitchen can assign.

clashingAllergies.description: Your profile allergens found in the primary menu. Warning only (UC-41).

CheckoutPreview.description: Price breakdown and warnings before confirming (UC-07, UC-08, UC-09). The backend is the source of truth for every amount.

cutoffAt.description: Last moment to order or cancel (BR-09).

available.description: `false` when the pin is beyond the max distance; only pick-up is offered (not an error).

feePerSlot.description: Fee per delivered slot (0 for pick-up).

promo.description: Result of `promoCode`, or `null` when none was sent.

reason.description: Why it was not applied (`TIER_DISCOUNT_LARGER` = not stackable and the tier gives more); `null` when applied.

PaymentSession.description: Midtrans Snap session for a pending gateway payment.

redirectUrl.description: Hosted payment page (alternative to the popup).

paymentSession.description: Present for `MIDTRANS`; `null` for `CASH` (pay at the cashier, admin verifies).

SkipRequest.description: Skip a slot (UC-44). No refund; allowed until food-ready.

SkipDayRequest.description: "Skip Hari Ini": skip all your skippable slots on a date (UC-44).

subscriptionId.description: Limit to one order; omit for all your orders.

skipReason.description: Optional reason written to every skipped slot.

FoodReadyRequest.description: "Makanan Siap" (UC-39), one-way. Either a production group (`menuScheduleId`, optionally only primary or alternative portions) or explicit `orderIds` (special category). Only `Disiapkan` slots change: delivery → `Diantar`, pick-up → `Siap Diambil`.

usesAlternativeMenu.description: Group filter: only alternative (`true`) or only primary (`false`) portions; omit for both.

StockUpdateRequest.description: Set the counted stock (UC-32, UC-40). Stock never decreases automatically.

CourierDelivery.description: One item on the courier's to-do list (UC-30). Only the courier's own `Success`, non-skipped delivery slots.

MidtransNotification.description: Midtrans HTTP notification (only the fields the backend reads are listed). Verified with `signature_key = SHA512(order_id + status_code + gross_amount + serverKey)`; the backend then re-fetches the status from Midtrans before updating anything. Mapping of `transaction_status` to stored statuses: `settlement`/`capture`(accept) → `Success`, `pending` → `Pending`, `expire` → `Expire`; other values are still an open decision (AGENTS.md).

status_code.description: HTTP-like status code as a string.

gross_amount.description: Amount as a string with 2 decimals.

IncomeReport.description: Gross income (UC-31) from `Success` orders created in the period, including verified cash. `Expire` and `Dibatalkan` are excluded; skipped slots still count (UC-44).

SlotStatusEvent.description: A slot changed status. Sent to the slot's customer, its courier, kitchen and admins.

SlotObstacleEvent.description: A courier/admin wrote an obstacle note. Sent to the customer and admins.

SlotMenuEvent.description: The kitchen switched a slot to (or back from) the alternative menu. Sent to the customer.

NotificationEvent.description: A new customer-level notification for the connected user.

AnnouncementEvent.description: A new package/global/schedule announcement relevant to the connected customer.
